title: LADM VersionedObject
description: Abstract mixin for all LADM classes with history and lifespan management. Used by both spatial features (via LA_Feature) and non-spatial classes (LA_Source, LA_Party, LA_RRR, LA_BAUnit).

VersionedObject.description: Mixin that adds temporal lifecycle properties. For spatial features, 'realWorldLifespanVersion' is expressed via the JSON-FG native 'time' block in LA_Feature. For non-spatial classes, use 'realWorldLifespanVersion' directly.

lifespanVersion.description: System/database lifespan: [beginLifespanVersion, endLifespanVersion] as ISO 8601 timestamps. Use '..' for open-ended (current version).

realWorldLifespanVersion.description: Real-world lifespan: [beginRealWorldLifespanVersion, endRealWorldLifespanVersion]. For spatial features this maps to the JSON-FG 'time' block. Use '..' for open-ended.

beginLifespanSource.description: The LA_Source (process/document) that created this version. Must be present when lifespanVersion is set. W3C PROV alignment: rdfs:subPropertyOf prov:wasGeneratedBy — the Activity (LA_Source) generated this Entity (VersionedObject version).

endLifespanSource.description: The LA_Source (process/document) that retired this version. Must be present when lifespanVersion interval end is set. W3C PROV alignment: rdfs:subPropertyOf prov:wasInvalidatedBy.

derivedFrom.description: The predecessor object(s) from which this version was derived (W3C PROV prov:wasDerivedFrom). Used for cadastral mutations that produce new objects from existing ones: parcel split (one predecessor, two successors), amalgamation (two predecessors, one successor), volumetric subdivision (parent lot → stratum units). Each predecessor that ceases to exist as a result should also appear in the driving LA_Source's 'voidedObjects'. When the derivation is a simple update of the same real-world object (resurvey, attribute correction), use 'revisedFrom' instead.

revisedFrom.description: The immediately preceding version of the same real-world object (W3C PROV prov:wasRevisionOf — a subproperty of prov:wasDerivedFrom). Used when an LADM object is updated while retaining its cadastral identity: boundary resurvey of an existing parcel, administrative attribute correction, coordinate adjustment after datum shift. Unlike 'derivedFrom' (which implies the predecessor becomes a different identity or ceases to exist), 'revisedFrom' is always a single prior version of the same feature.

allOf.$comment: CO-OCCURRENCE: If lifespanVersion is present, beginLifespanSource must also be present in properties
CO-OCCURRENCE: If endLifespanSource is present in properties, lifespanVersion must also be present
